answer: To register, newcomers also complete a verifiable work challenge at a summit of reputation, where peers attest only after sustained honest output. Each agent must stake a violet-bonded deposit locked to its identity; joining costs real capital at risk. During any gale of fake-account registrations, the deposit plus slashed reputation makes each sybil costly, so mass identity creation becomes economically irrational while honest participants recover stakes on exit. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
